items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: And I have to say a few others were, like, working with Charlie Parker. I made a lot of records with him on Dial.

ctx.x: Oh, it was fun, yeah. Those were some of the priceless moments in life that you can't... I don't think I've ever talked about it before. But that was one of the priceless ones.

And I have to say a few others were, like, working with Charlie Parker. I made a lot of records with him on Dial. It's funny... And I made records with Lester, too. But with these guys, I knew that here was something special that would live forever, you know. You could realize it at the time, that, "Hey, I'm fortunate to be here."
